concerns.text: FR-002 requires a composition‑only graph with exactly four node features (atomic number, electronegativity, valence electrons, atomic radius). Task T004 builds a graph with five features by adding `element_fraction`, which deviates from the specification and leaves FR‑002 uncovered.

FR-005 mandates downloading each CIF via the Materials Project REST API and verifying per‑material checksums. Task T011 acquires a pre‑packaged CIF archive from Zenodo and does not perform per‑material API retrieval, violating the functional requirement and leaving FR‑005 uncovered.

FR-011 explicitly requires CIF files to be fetched from `https://materialsproject.org/rest/v2/materials/{mpid}/cif` with checksum verification. The current task T011 does not use this endpoint, so the requirement is not satisfied.
